Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Vaishnavi

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center

:
D62jHP
Problem Description
:
Router connection issue - SCB offline
We have checked and found SCB to be offline.
As we can see, the charger is online on OCPP, we would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" backend and check if SCB comes back online.
Once done, do let us know. Because a
fter this, if still it is showing offline, then site intervention will be needed to check further and then will inform to our field service team to check the router connection.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0376051
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vaishnavi Raut
